sloka: यदि कश्चित् प्रदाता मे विषस्याद्य भवेदिह ।क्षिप्रं वैवस्वतं देव पश्येयं पतिना विना ।। ५.२६.३८।।।।
transliteration: yadi kaścit pradātā me viṣasyādya bhavediha ।kṣipraṁ vaivasvataṁ deva paśyeyaṁ patinā vinā ।। 5.26.38।।।।

translations.english: "If I can find some one who can give me poison now I shall soon see the lord of death without my lord.
